author: easemize
name: material-ui-dropdown-menu
description: A highly sophisticated Material Design 3 Dropdown Menu built on top of shadcn/ui and Radix UI. Engineered with a custom Dual-Physics Ripple Engine via the Web Animations API for true geometric haptic-like feedback. Features a seamless drill-down navigation system with smooth, dynamic height adjustments using ResizeObserver. Includes SSR-compatible cinematic sweep & staggered entry animations driven by local CSS variables. Fully WCAG compliant, keyboard navigable, and perfectly bundled as a zero-dependency, single-file portable component.
